newsitem.title: USA: PanEnergy in tentative production deal.
newsitem.headline: PanEnergy in tentative production deal.

text.p: Mobile Bay Processing Partners has entered into a letter of intent with Mobil Exploration & Producing U.S. Inc to process Mobil's natural gas production from the Mobile Bay area, a statement issued by PanEnergy Corp said Wednesday.
Mobile Bay Processing was formed recently to construct, own and operate a liquids handling and gas processing facility for Mobile Bay area production.
The partnership venture is owned by subsidiaries of PanEnergy Corp, with 49.5 percent; MCN Energy Group Inc, 49.5 percent; and Offshore Energy Development Corp, one percent.
Mobil's gas would be processed at Mobile Bay Processing's planned Mobile Bay processing plant, the first major natural gas liquids processing plant in southern Alabama, PanEnergy said.
The plant would process up to 300 million cubic feet per day from Mobil's gas-sweetening plant near Coden, Ala., PanEnergy said.
Based on current plans, Mobile Bay Processing expects to begin construction this summer, with a targeted in-service date of June 1998, PanEnergy said.
